thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: tenant=therion-prod in vpc-dedicated-4 experiencing elevated tail latency for text-gen endpoints (>10s p99). rolling page to #eng-oncall.

maya: got it, I'm oncall now. seeing the same in console, p99 ~ 11.2s, throughput unchanged. marking impact: customer calls degraded UX.

aj: looking at the tenant queue for therion-prod on pool ded-4. queue length spiking, per-tenant max_batch_tokens appears to be inherited default 1024.

sam: cc @aj and @maya - infra shows sustained long KV cache lookups on that pool (GPU 0 + GPU 1). not CPU hot, GPU utilization ~62%, but many small batches causing serialization overhead.

leo: customer success pinged: "Therion noticing timeouts for long prompts, some retries. they hit our support SLA window." Julie is on call with them.

julie (cust-success): on the call now, they're routing to their users, asking for ETA. they can tolerate a short mitigation now; they want us to avoid heavy config that might change output quality.

maya: plan: try bespoke tenant scheduler knobs for therion-prod: reduce max_batch_tokens and enable batch_coalesce_timeout tuning to prioritize latency over throughput. Will coordinate safe rollback.

aj: agreed. Proposed delta: set tenant override: `max_batch_tokens: 512` (was 1024), `batch_coalesce_ms: 6` (was 20), `max_inflight_batches: 2` (was 4). This reduces batching depth and coalesce wait.

opsbot: REMINDER: applying tenant overrides to dedicated pools requires a dynamic patch via /ops/tenant-config API; change staged to canary on node ded-4a first.

maya: executing patch on ded-4a canary now. command:```bash
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/tenant-config/therion-prod/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"max_batch_tokens":512,"batch_coalesce_ms":6,"max_inflight_batches":2}'
```

aj: watching metrics. tail latency p99 for canary node decreased from 11.2s -> 6.3s within 30s. p95 from 1.8s -> 1.1s. throughput per node down ~8% but overall latency improved.

sam: good. no adverse GPU mem pressure seen. logs show fewer KV fetch bursts.

maya: rolling to remaining ded-4 nodes with a 20s pause between nodes. starting ded-4b.

opsbot: deploy recorded: patch applied to ded-4b by maya at 2245679120.

aj: ded-4b p99 -> 6.5s. queue length reduced from ~120 -> ~40 on the tenant queue.

leo: passing update to Julie: "We applied a latency-first scheduler tweak; you should see fewer timeouts. We're monitoring for quality changes."

julie (cust-success): they reported a quick improvement on their side, some users back online. thanking the team.

maya: full roll complete. final node patched at 2245679580.

aj: aggregate metrics after full roll: p99 ~6.4s, p95 ~1.2s, error/retry rate down 72%. cost per token slightly up due to more frequent smaller batches, but within the committed SLA for Dedicated.

sam: adding ephemeral alert suppression for Therion for 15m to avoid noisy pages while we observe.

opsbot: suppression applied by sam until 2245680450.

maya: action items: 1) short-term: keep these overrides for 2 hours then evaluate with telemetry; 2) mid-term: work with eng-runtime to create a tailored batching profile for therion that balances their long-prompt traffic patterns; 3) postmortem: capture trigger (sudden prompt-size shift + inherited high max_batch_tokens).

aj: dev-note: need an internal `tenant-batching-profiles` schema in configstore to support named profiles (e.g., "latency-first", "throughput-first") and route tenants to profiles instead of ad-hoc overrides. I'll open a ticket.

leo: I'll coordinate customer follow-up and schedule a sync with Therion to discuss longer-term profile.

maya: oncall handoff: I'm handing to @aj in 10m but I'll remain reachable. if p99 creeps back above 9s, rollback plan is to restore previous values and enable `prefetch_kv:true` for the tenant.

aj: ack. I'll pick up after maya's handoff. Also adding a temporary dashboard widget for therion-prod to track batch sizes distribution and coalesce latency.

julie (cust-success): Therion thanks the team, wants a 1:1 tomorrow to review performance and possible config changes.

maya: closing the live mitigation portion. leaving note: "Applied latency-first override for therion-prod: max_batch_tokens=512, batch_coalesce_ms=6, max_inflight_batches=2; monitor for quality regressions and cost impact."

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied, customer impact reduced. file an incident ticket and include timing + config diffs.

aj: filing ticket now: INC-224567-therion-batching-tweak. attaching perf graphs and the exact override payload.

sam: will run a short-lived synthetic load (long prompt distribution) against a sandbox of therion to validate recommended profile before we convert to a permanent profile.

maya: handoff complete. leaving the thread for follow-ups. thanks all :thumbsup:

opsbot: Note: remember to remove suppression at 2245680450 or extend with justification.
